spectral_argument: U=XZ is unitary; XUX=U* pairs nonreal eigenvalues; odd dimension leaves one eigenvalue +1 or -1
theorem: For Hermitian involutions X,Z in odd complex dimension, U=XZ is unitary and its nonreal eigenvalues occur in conjugate pairs. An unpaired eigenvalue is therefore +1 or -1, on which U+U*=XZ+ZX has eigenvalue +2 or -2. Hence the operator-norm anticommutation defect is at least 2, and the bound is sharp. Odd dimension cannot even approximate an involutive Clifford pair below this fixed error.
